probe: sf-mail-library against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.4 §12, gate 20); the behaviour simai/ui-mail package/tests/browser/mail-library held for it: the groups and their rows, the search, nothing found, the chips with «Все», the places with the current variant marked and never offered again, and the add and replace events
format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <sf-mail-library id="library"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"groups":[{"id":"basics","title":"Основа"},{"id":"commerce","title":"Товары"}],"items":[{"type":"heading","title":"Заголовок","purpose":"Главная мысль письма","icon":"title","group":"basics"},{"type":"text","title":"Текст","purpose":"Абзац или два","icon":"notes","group":"basics"},{"type":"price","title":"Цена","purpose":"Цена и старая цена","icon":"sell","group":"commerce"},{"type":"hidden","title":"Без группы","purpose":"Не показывается","icon":"help","group":"nowhere"}],"places":[{"family":"header","title":"Шапка","current":"header-logo","items":[{"type":"header-logo","title":"Логотип","purpose":"Логотип по центру","icon":"image"},{"type":"header-band","title":"Полоса","purpose":"Цветная полоса с логотипом","icon":"view_carousel"}]}]}</script></sf-mail-library>

<sf-mail-library id="stale" category="nowhere"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"groups":[{"id":"basics","title":"Основа"},{"id":"commerce","title":"Товары"}],"items":[{"type":"heading","title":"Заголовок","purpose":"Главная мысль письма","icon":"title","group":"basics"},{"type":"text","title":"Текст","purpose":"Абзац или два","icon":"notes","group":"basics"},{"type":"price","title":"Цена","purpose":"Цена и старая цена","icon":"sell","group":"commerce"},{"type":"hidden","title":"Без группы","purpose":"Не показывается","icon":"help","group":"nowhere"}]}</script></sf-mail-library>

probes.title: the groups are drawn in their order, the places after them; a row per block, and a block of a group nobody named is not drawn; the search field is there

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#library'); return [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-mail-library-group')].map((g) => g.dataset.group).join(',') === 'basics,commerce,pinned-header' && [...document.querySelectorAll('#library [data-add]')].map((row) => row.dataset.add).join(',') === 'heading,text,price' && el.querySelector('sf-input') !== null; })()

probes.title: a row's accessible name is the block's words, then the action; the icons are aria-hidden and add nothing to it (WCAG 2.5.3)

steps.check: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('#library [data-add="heading"]'); const words = [...row.querySelectorAll('.sf-mail-library-row-words > span')].map((one) => one.textContent.trim()).join(' '); const icons = [...row.querySelectorAll('sf-icon')].every((icon) => icon.closest('[aria-hidden="true"]')); return words === 'Заголовок Главная мысль письма Добавить' && icons && row.querySelector('.sr-only').textContent.trim() === 'Добавить' && row.closest('[role=group]').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Основа'; })()

probes.title: a click and Enter on a row each send sf-mail-library-add {type} once

the search keeps the rows whose words match, the places' variants included («цен» finds «по центру»), and drops a group left empty; the field writes query as the person types, and a block is found by its type too
a search that finds nothing says so with sf-empty-state «Ничего не найдено», and draws no row

steps.check: (() => { const empty = document.querySelector('#library sf-empty-state[kind="nothing-found"]'); return document.querySelectorAll('#library [data-add], #library [data-variant]').length === 0 && empty !== null && empty.getAttribute('heading') === 'Ничего не найдено'; })()

probes.title: the chips are «Все» and one per group, «Все» pressed; a chip shows its group only and hides the places; «Все» brings them back
a category no group has shows every group: a stale filter never leaves the Library empty

the variant the letter has now is marked, says «сейчас в письме» and is never offered again: pressing it sends nothing and replace answers refused current; another variant sends sf-mail-library-replace {family, type} once
probes.covers: settings.places current, events.replace, actions.replace, runtime.current-text, runtime.change-variant-text

steps.check: (() => { const variants = [...document.querySelectorAll('#library [data-variant]')]; const current = document.querySelector('#library [data-variant="header-logo"]'); const other = document.querySelector('#library [data-variant="header-band"]'); return variants.map((row) => `${row.dataset.variant}:${row.getAttribute('aria-pressed')}`).join(',') === 'header-logo:true,header-band:false' && current.classList.contains('is-selected') && current.querySelector('.sr-only').textContent.trim() === 'сейчас в письме' && other.querySelector('.sr-only').textContent.trim() === 'Сменить вариант: Шапка'; })()
